cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me put this little plant on your windowsill. It only needs a corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One small plant won't block the light.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That gives us the rule. I'll put the second one at the other end, where it won't shade this one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said the light was the problem. Stand back and check it from there; if the room is just as bright, I'll keep them both.

reason: Remove below-glass geometry; use the actual room-light rationale and A directed brightness check to press the broader claim.
